The '''DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant''' was a [[hyperbaride synthesis plant]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. Initially the [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] plant was owned by [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]], but the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nationalized the company and the plant fell into their hands. [[Vost Tyne]] became the [[Managing Director|managing director]] of the plant after he assassinated its previous [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], [[Arviz Linden]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents who crash-landed on Marca tried to shut it down with the help of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Marci Sertim|Marci]] and [[Darci Sertim]] after learning about its harmful effects on Marca's ecosystem and native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Sekct]]. The facility was destroyed after Marci overloaded the plant's [[Hyperbattery|hyperbatteries]].
